tools.limitations: Built-in terrain maps illustrate pinned restrictions; they do not reproduce every dynamic obstruction.

bundles.limitations: Remixed bundles can change the requirements. Saved donations are applied to a standard bundle only when its full definition matches.

museum.limitations: The display is a practice grid. Exact Museum room geometry is outside its scope.

predictor.limitations: Offer and event predictions depend on the input seed, the opening count or the game date. Exact results for every save are unverified.

tracker.limitations: Personal saves are processed in the separate workspace. Supported observations vary with the file and game version.

crop-calculator.limitations: The example excludes other costs, speed bonuses and processing. Multi-crop scenarios depend on budget, seed price, quality and machine capacity.

fair-calculator.limitations: Results depend on the entered sale price, quality, category and which items are active in the display.

fishing.limitations: The collection table uses location-specific references. Alternate sources and special bait can change catch conditions.

perfection.limitations: The result is a reference estimate. Unrecorded save categories remain unknown, and the game’s tracker is the reference for an in-game score.

crafting.limitations: Direct materials, unlocks and profession substitutions depend on the selected recipe. The result covers the supported recipe catalogue.

shipping.limitations: This checklist covers the items for Full Shipment. Season and acquisition hints may omit some valid sources.

cooking.limitations: Owning an unlocked recipe does not count as cooking it. Ingredient alternatives and intermediate stock can affect other recipes.

golden-walnuts.limitations: The guide groups walnut sources and provides documented coordinate hints. It uses a schematic plot for location guidance.

farm-comparison.limitations: The counts depend on the reference terrain flags and modeled starter occupancy. Use them for planning comparisons.

grandpa-calculator.limitations: The score depends on the milestones you enter. Community Center restoration and its ceremony have separate inputs.

skills.limitations: Experience determines the displayed skill level. Profession choices and mastery use separate data.
